newsitem.title: USA: Brooks Fiber sees more network spending.
newsitem.headline: Brooks Fiber sees more network spending.

text.p: Brooks Fiber Properties Inc, a local telecommunications services company, said Tuesday it expects spending on network expansion to continue but is confident in its investments.

"While we expect further expansion will require ongoing investment, we are confident that we are successfully developing assets that will generate future high-margin revenue growth," said James Allen, chief executive of Brooks.
In 1996, Brooks said acquisitions and development activities increased its number of networks in operation to 23 from 11 in 1995.

Brooks said network utilization increased during 1996, with the total buildings connected rising to 2,121 from 216 at the end of 1995. The company said it had networks covering 1,059 route miles at the year end versus 262 route miles at the end of 1995.
Earlier, Brooks reported a fourth quarter net loss of $0.58 a share versus a net loss of $0.13 a share the previous year. Revenues were $17.428 million versus $3.851 million.
